purpose: Response-blind census deciding whether a globally consistent environmental-niche relation can support a fresh dyadic TTF test.

freshness.species_universe: phylogatR metadata-eligible species after all prior empirical and hypothesis-generating species exclusions

external_occurrence_contract.source: GBIF occurrence records via a separately versioned acquisition receipt
external_occurrence_contract.coordinate_requirements: finite valid latitude/longitude; reject zero coordinates and records with declared coordinate issues under the acquisition contract
external_occurrence_contract.note: candidate occurrence thresholds are feasibility parameters, not yet the final primary relation definition; feasibility results cannot be joined to genetic outcomes

environment_contract.representation: one common environmental feature space across all retained species
environment_contract.pca: global PCA fit without genetic outcomes; exact rasters, versions, scaling and retained axes must be frozen after feasibility and before response opening

feasibility_outputs_allowed: correlation of candidate niche overlap with geographic co-support and lineage proximity
feasibility_outputs_forbidden: association of any ecological relation with genetic response
selection of variables or thresholds using genetic response

provisional_pass_criteria.species_with_usable_external_niche: >= 500 fresh species before final panel split
provisional_pass_criteria.nondegenerate_relation: candidate R_st must not be effectively binary or constant; report quantiles and effective unique values
provisional_pass_criteria.geography_separability: candidate R_st must retain substantial within-geographic-support variation; no pass/fail numeric threshold may be invented after seeing genetic response
provisional_pass_criteria.taxonomic_breadth: report order composition and concentration; final panel must not silently collapse to one order
provisional_pass_criteria.dyad_support: report eligible dyads per source and target before choosing final development/confirmatory sizes
